items.title: Breakfast: eat well
items.note: Lunch is not until 13:30, so eat more at breakfast and take some fruit and bread as snacks.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Last morning at the Panda Hotel
items.note: No rush: panda-themed décor photos, time in the hotel kids' area, or rest in the room.

items.title: Pack, check out
items.note: Panda Hotel checkout is 12:00 at the latest.
items.tip: Check the room before leaving; Chimelong souvenirs are easily left behind.

items.title: Panda Hotel → K Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~50 min–1 hr. Navigate to “From K Hotel 体育西路”. With many bags, book a 6-seater.

items.title: Check in or store luggage
items.note: If early check-in is not available, luggage is stored.

items.title: Walk to Grandview Mall (正佳广场)
items.note: ~10 min. One of Guangzhou's largest malls, each floor with a different theme. Go straight to 6F for lunch.

food.name: Uncle Qiu Lemon Tea, Tianhe South (丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）)
food.desc: 80 Tianhe South Road; signature duck-shit oolong lemon tea (鸭屎香柠檬茶). One can be picked up on the way.

food.name: Cha Li Yi Shi, Tianhe South Road 1 (茶理宜世（天河南一路店）)
food.desc: 92 Tianhe South Road 1; the milk tea option.

items.title: Lunch: Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居), Grandview Mall branch
items.note: Grandview Mall 6F, unit 6C059. Sunday lunch is busy; call before leaving Chimelong to check the queue: 020-38373301.

food.name: Char siu buns, chicken feet (叉烧包、凤爪)
Malay sponge cake, red rice roll (马拉糕、红米肠)

items.tip: Dishes already eaten at the Dishifu Road flagship on the 23rd can be swapped for others this time.

items.title: Grandview 3F: sports brands
items.note: Tennis shoes and sportswear. If time allows, neighbouring Teemall (天河城) and Parc Central (天环广场) are worth a look.

items.title: Fashion Tianhe (时尚天河): anime, collectible toys
items.note: ~10 min walk from Grandview to beneath Tianhe Sports Center. Anime, designer toys and budget shops are concentrated here.
items.tip: Children should be accompanied by an adult or older teen.

items.title: Walk back to the hotel
items.note: Either option: walk back to the hotel, ~10 min.

food.name: Grandview 5F–7F restaurants (正佳五至七楼餐厅)
food.desc: Grandview's main dining floors, all cuisines; ~10 min walk

food.name: Chinese restaurant, Grandview Marriott (正佳万豪酒店中餐厅)
food.desc: Right beside Grandview Mall; suited to a proper Cantonese meal

food.name: Tiyu Xilu local eateries (体育西路小馆)
food.desc: Neighbourhood roast meats and claypot congee; nearest and fastest

intro:
Slow morning; check out of the Panda Hotel
Move to K Hotel, Tianhe
Lunch: Tao Tao Ju, Grandview Mall
Afternoon: Option A sports brands / Option B anime and toys
